pages.text:
Ghibli.
You’re not like everyone else.
Bold, graceful, assertive and elegant, Maserati Ghibli offers something unique in a
world of conformity.
Ghibli delivers the comfort you’d expect in a luxury sports sedan — yet it
distinguishes itself with razor-sharp, sports car handling. This balance, a signature of
Maserati, is a source of endless inspiration — whether you’re heading to the office or
breaking loose for an exhilarating drive.
For 2021, Ghibli features a restyled signature Trident grille that announces your
daring character. Also new are the taillamps inspired by the Giugiaro-penned
Maserati 3200 GT “boomerang” rear lights which will be a delight for all followers to
admire.
Inside, the redesigned instrument cluster and the new 10.1-inch frameless HD
screen with Maserati Intelligent Assistant (MIA) multimedia system will make your
driving experience even more intuitive and engaging.
A core offering of all Maserati vehicles is the ability to cover long distances at
dynamic yet refined high speed. With the Ghibli, the power that delivers this comes
from a choice of V6 and V8 petrol engines, together with the V6 diesel and the new
hybrid version.
Whatever your choice or ambition, Maserati Ghibli always offers a uniquely
inspirational answer.
